 TMZ Updated Thu, October 22, 2026 at 4:27 PM UTC Add Yahoo as a preferred source to see more of our stories on Google. Britt McHenry was back in the sports spotlight Wednesday night ... but the former ESPN reporter wasn't calling the action, she was causing it ... throwing a drink on a fan and getting escorted out of an NBA game to a chorus of boos ... and it's all on video.
